cases.title: An IR's Investors lists only the investors from their own leads, in the IR columns
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
expected: The page heading reads Investors and the line under it says 5 from your leads.
The table columns are Investor, ARL ID, Farms, State and Lead.
The list includes Prakash Bhat with ARL ID ARL-INV-0208, Block B ×1, reserved.
The list includes Abhijit Sen, Anjali Deshpande, Sanjay Kulkarni and T. Balasubramanian.
The list does not include Radhika Menon.

cases.title: An IR's investor list shows no money, KYC, tier or identity column and no Add investor button
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
expected: The table has no Paid column and no Due column.
The table has no KYC column, no PAN, no Aadhaar and no bank column.
The page has no Add investor button.
No amount in rupees is shown anywhere on the page.

cases.title: An IR opens one of their investors: read-only, with no money or paper sections
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
Press 'Prakash Bhat' on the row of ARL-INV-0208
expected: The record is headed Prakash Bhat with ARL ID ARL-INV-0208.
The record's sections are Who they are, What they hold and Journey.
The record has no Money section and no Paper section.
The Who they are section shows Prakash Bhat's name, mobile, email and residency.
The section says this is the IR's own investor, read only.
No PAN, Aadhaar or bank detail is shown.

cases.title: An IR's What they hold shows units and land but no price, amount or hold controls
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
Press 'Prakash Bhat' on the row of ARL-INV-0208
Press 'What they hold'
expected: The section shows Units 1.
The section shows 1 on Block B — Doddaballapura.
The section says Reserved.
No amount in rupees, no price per unit and no amount due is shown.
There is no Release the reservation button and no Extend the hold button.

cases.title: A different IR sees only their own investors
steps: Press Kavya Nair on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
expected: The list includes Radhika Menon.
The list does not include Prakash Bhat.
The list does not include Sanjay Kulkarni.

cases.title: An IR's search box narrows only their own list
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
Type 'Prakash' in the text box on the heading row, next to '5 from your leads'
expected: The list shows Prakash Bhat.
The list does not show Sanjay Kulkarni.
The list does not show Radhika Menon.

cases.title: An IR's search for another IR's investor finds nobody
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
Type 'Radhika' in the text box on the heading row, next to '5 from your leads'
expected: A message says nobody matches that.
No investor row is shown.

cases.title: An IR's rail has Investors, between Events and Payments, and no other Investors-side page
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
expected: The menu shows Investors, after Events and before Payments.
The menu shows Today, Leads, Activity, Events, Investors, Payments and Documents.
The menu does not show Farms.
The menu does not show Tickets.
The menu does not show Investor updates.
The menu does not show Teams, Plan, Transfers, Numbers or System.

cases.title: An IR follows the lead link from an investor back to their own lead
steps: Press Rohit Deshpande on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors'
Press 'Open lead for Prakash Bhat'
expected: The lead page for Prakash Bhat opens.
The page is the lead page, not the Investors list.
